title: AI & Chatbot | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: AI & Chatbot. Category: Development. Duration: 5 months. Description: Building a chatbot -- computer software that conducts an online chat conversation via text or text-to-speech in place of providing direct contact with a live human agent. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
